method: static AST read: function writes JSON + mentions cache/replay -> the literal keys it reads back off the cache name, the digest names it hands to the call that returns the cache, and whether the module has any digest; then (r1378) whether the value it reads came off disk and reaches a caller, because only then can it be an earlier tick's number
limits: a key listed here is not proof the cache is safe, a digest in the module is not proof it reaches this key, and a digest passed as an argument is not proof it is compared -- rows are a reading list, not a verdict list. reads_a_stored_value is a NAMED-BINDING read of a load call in the same function, plus (r1379) a value returned by a helper that checks identity keys before handing it over; a value handed in as an argument is still invisible. served_to_caller is a taint through `return` or into a json.dump payload -- a face that writes the number into its product serves it to whoever reads the product
